g.title: KayaRank1Convo2 begins.
g.text: KayaRank1Convo2 begins.

g.title: j1104156299
g.text: Hi. Why would Entrati's cross-temporal setup involve what appears to be an active connection to the Kinemantik Online Network?

g.title: j3785611984
g.text: Or, I guess, Hi. Is the internet required for time travel?

g.title: j3393030710
g.text: Right to it then, okay. No, the ‘internet’ didn’t make it to my time, really, so it can’t be required. Or maybe it is.

g.title: j1182211251
g.text: And hello to you too, Kaya.

g.title: j1754853053
g.text: So you do not need an internet connection to come and go as you please? Did Entrati?

g.title: j2587256468
g.text: Ugh. Internet? I could see how given the properties of a network..

g.title: j3275110905
g.text: I really don't know anything for sure. I just know there was a sequence, Entrati had a plan, and it involved me, here, now. I needed to get here, to meet you all.

g.title: j559333601
g.text: Okay, but why does there seem to be an internet connection that is non-negotiable in some of his notes?

g.title: j2736360748
g.text: I'll ask him next time I see him.

g.title: j2583678213
g.text: You have his notes?

g.title: j131950519
g.text: Is that a problem? Wouldn't a kid like you love the internet?

g.title: j1653679705
g.text: Not literally. Just what I saw when I found him. I don't think he expected to be found.

g.title: j2322558332
g.text: Check boolean KayaSetKid

g.title: j2325996856
g.text: Sorry, was making a joke... They have those in the future.

g.title: j1916629896
g.text: A joke. Lighten up.

g.title: j448789439
g.text: Boolean KayaSetFound is now true.

g.title: j1106498539
g.text: Does it make you feel better to keep calling me a kid? Like, don't you get it?

g.title: j2322558332->j1106498539
g.text: true

g.title: j170702684
g.text: You don't know anything about me.

g.title: j2322558332->j170702684
g.text: false

g.title: j1838092426
g.text: Fine.

g.title: j874650605
g.text: No.

g.title: j1912372578
g.text: YOU? You found Entrati, when no one else could?

g.title: j4291946302
g.text: You found him? How?

g.title: j142804569
g.text: I had to grow up FAST. The people on this f**** internet made sure of that.

g.title: j1557784581
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j837379113
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4107403813
g.text: I wanted answers.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.

g.title: j1557784581->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
j2679431777
g.text: And you're sure there's not internet in your future? Like totally sure?

g.title: j47211250
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2885656583
g.text: Actually, forget I said anything. I'll find out when I get there.

g.title: j767896213
g.text: Things changed too fast in this shithole. Especially in the internet backrooms talking about this Doktor.

g.title: j3027039915
g.text: So I found him, surprised him. And ohh my god. Grandpa Doktor was not happy but, I cut right to it.

g.title: j3252278142
g.text: I knew he was from the future. He knew I knew. He gave me a choice and well whatever. Now I found you.

g.title: j4280559115
g.text: And in a way I'm giving you a choice too. Help me, or regret it.

g.title: j3079435009
g.text: Charming. I'm not your enemy you know.

g.title: j1978441183
g.text: Do you threaten all your new friends?

g.title: j2107881851
g.text: Not yet anyway. People change. Guess we'll see.

g.title: j3122110215
g.text: Just protecting myself.
